translation: This medicine should only be decocted with water, not with wine; this method is quite effective. If the teeth are injured by a fall, blow, or chop but have not moved, apply Fu Rong Ointment (芙蓉膏); if the teeth are loose, burn the root of the tribulus (蒺藜根) preserving its nature, grind into powder, and rub it on frequently and they will become firm; using Gu Chi San (固齒散) to rub on from time to time is also good. <ins>Bu Ji San (補肌散)</ins> Stops bleeding and removes pain, wards off wind and rejoins sinews and bones, and generates flesh.
